cold_open.hook: Supreme Court blocks Trump's Fed firing—Lisa Cook stays, markets pop 0.74%, and the guardrails just got real.

markets.macro_note: Tech leads as Fed independence survives; healthcare stumbles on policy uncertainty.

big_story.story_title: Fed's Lisa Cook can stay on at central bank while challenging Trump's attempt to fire her, Supreme Court rules
big_story.angle: The Supreme Court just told Trump he can't unilaterally purge the Fed—a massive institutional check that reframes the entire power dynamic between the White House and monetary policy for the next four years.

quick_hits.angle: Supreme Court nukes FTC independence—commissioners can now be fired at will, handing tech regulation back to whoever controls the White House.
Alphabet joins the Dow, signaling the index is finally admitting tech isn't a bubble—it's the economy now.
The 'anti-woke' crusade is now targeting federal science funding—watch for brain drain as researchers flee to Canada and Europe.
Oil near pre-war lows but supply risks loom—OPEC's holding its breath waiting to see if the Middle East stays quiet.

odd_thing.joke_angle: Teyana Taylor's tears and a Lauryn Hill tribute stole the BET Awards—proof that genuine emotion still beats a choreographed TikTok moment.

sign_off.callback_target: Lisa Cook and the Fed's institutional independence—the one guardrail that actually held.
